name: Vanta Network
description:
Vanta Network is a decentralized ecosystem built to democratize access to advanced financial trading strategies through the integration of artificial intelligence and blockchain technology.

The network functions as a specialized subnet on the Bittensor platform, specifically identified as Subnet 8.
It incentivizes quantitative and machine learning models to provide high-performing trading signals across multiple asset classes including forex, equities, and cryptocurrencies.

Participants are evaluated and rewarded based on a competitive, risk-adjusted scoring system that prioritizes consistent returns and capital preservation.
